instruction: Please help me install the Remote SSH extension in VS Code.

metadata.explanation: Task requires installing the Remote SSH extension (ms-vscode-remote.remote-ssh) in VS Code. Evaluator verifies the extension is installed by checking if 'ms-vscode-remote.remote-ssh' appears in the list of installed extensions.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts the required state by executing 'code --list-extensions' to list all installed VS Code extensions
Metric function 'is_extension_installed' correctly uses the rules parameter and performs a string containment check
Expected value is semantically correct - checking for the exact extension ID 'ms-vscode-remote.remote-ssh'
Complete coverage - the single requirement (install the extension) is fully verified
Evaluator handles edge cases correctly (extension not installed will result in empty output and failed check)
Data flow is correct: command output -> string containment check -> pass/fail verdict
No dependency on transient UI state - uses reliable CLI command that works regardless of VS Code window state
